events.title: Disorderly Twins presents: 'The 27 CLUB'
events.description:
Back by popular demand:
(Not really... 🙃 We just had to wait for C-word regulations to pull this event off safely)


Disorderly Twins in association with @Set For The Sky brings you yet another incredibly mediocre sequel to the lives of Alex and JD. Only this time, the twins are tasked with fighting the existential dread of getting old AND surviving the 27 club.So here’s a good excuse to dust off that suit/ dress, make yourself snazzy (Only if you want to) and join us for the premiere of the twins’ 27th year on this flat earth.


Discounted food and adult refreshments will be available during the premiere event.
Date: Saturday, June 5th 2021.
Time: [TBC]
Place: @Antonio's Pizza Place
Dress Code: “Formal” – (Highly optional, the boys will be in suits/character, but rather dress warm, honestly.)
